issue.title: Add pr-demo-video agent skill for Cursor and Claude Code
issue.body:
## Summary

Add the shared `pr-demo-video` agent skill so Cursor and Claude Code can record polished PR demo screencasts (Playwright + overlay cursor/captions + ffmpeg postprocess).

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] Skill lives in-repo for both Cursor (`.cursor/skills/pr-demo-video/`) and Claude Code (`.claude/skills/pr-demo-video/`)
- [ ] Core skill files match the shared skill (SKILL.md, overlay.js, postprocess.sh, record_ui_flow.py, record_agent_flow.py)
- [ ] Demo output directory (`.playwright-mcp/`) is gitignored
- [ ] Brief pointer in agent onboarding/docs so agents discover the skill
- [ ] Runtime deps (playwright, ffmpeg) documented as required only when recording — not for install

## Notes

Example recorder scripts are SkyPortal-oriented; adapt CONFIG/FLOW per PR / per app at usage time. Fluent Mobile is Android-native — browser UI recording applies when demoing a web surface or adapting selectors for the target under test.
